limitations.title: LIRF PARKING RESTRICTION
limitations.description: 0500-2200Z – 1 HR TURNAROUND ONLY. 2200-0500Z – OVERNIGHT PARKING ALLOWED ONLY IF DEPARTURE IS NOT LATER THAN 0500Z IN THE MORNING.

limitations.title: DENGUE DESINFECTION
limitations.description: Due to the increase of this disease, Italian health authorities require a CERTIFICATION OF RESIDUAL DISINSECTION (as per ANNEX 9 ICAO) for all the aircrafts that visited or transit in the last 28 days the areas of frequent/continuous Dengue risk indicated on the following link :  https://www.cdc.gov/dengue/areas-with-risk/index.html. **The certificate is requested prior to arrival**   If this is not the case and this a/c didn’t fly from/to the countries at Dengue risk in the last 28 days preceding the scheduled date of the flight, please fill in and sign the declaration form.
